periods.time: After the Caldia battlefield is evacuated

name.zh: 史黛菈悲悼卡尔迪亚并挑战比翼
name.en: Stella Grieves Caldia and Chooses to Challenge Edelweiss

periods.summary: Stella thanks Ikki and the others for limiting damage but breaks down over the eighty-three deaths at Caldia. She condemns her own weakness as Vermillion's sword and refuses Nene's offer to train only for survival. Believing only the world's strongest swordswoman might force impossible growth in one week, she decides to go to Edelberg and challenge Edelweiss before the representative war.
periods.cause: The deaths at Caldia and the presence of Desperado-class enemies convince Stella that ordinary growth and self-preservation are insufficient.
periods.process: Ikki tries to support without dismissing her grief; Sirius arrives and argues with Lunaeyes; Nene warns Stella that Or-Gaule would kill her quickly; Stella rejects mere self-protection and names Edelweiss as her target.
periods.outcome: Stella immediately flies to Estonia with Ikki, Alice, and Tatara, while Nene stays behind to prepare in Caldia.
periods.significance: Launches the Edelberg training arc and establishes Stella's dangerous initial self-sacrificial mindset.
